collection.description: A villager says goodnight to the trees on the way home, and tonight a child is following and watching.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Every evening, on the way home, (subject) says goodnight to the trees. Not all of them. Just the ones along (subject.his/her) path. "Goodnight, tall one. Goodnight, crooked one. Goodnight, you with the bird's nest." Tonight (friend) has been following a few steps behind, watching very closely.

choices.label: Explain That It's Just a Silly Habit

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "Can I do one?" (friend) asks. "Of course," says (subject). "Pick one that looks tired." (friend) picks a short, scruffy palm and wishes it goodnight with tremendous seriousness. Then another, and another. They get home very late, because (friend) has decided every single tree looks tired tonight.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "It's just something I do," (subject) says, a little embarrassed. (friend) thinks about this for a few steps. "I don't think it's silly," (friend.he/she) says. "I think the trees like it." (subject) has no answer for that. (subject.He/She) says goodnight to the crooked one a little louder than usual.
